 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. With its starting quarterback finally healthy after six-week absence, UCF heads to Kansas in search of snapping its 12-game road losing streak.
 Alonza Barnett III is expected to return to the starting lineup for the visiting Knights (4-4, 2-3 Big 12). He sustained a hamstring injury on the final drive of a Sept. 12 loss at Pittsburgh, but returned in the third quarter last week against Baylor when Keyone Jenkins reaggravated an ankle injury. The James Madison transfer is 39-of-65 passing through three appearances, totaling 477 yards with two touchdowns and one interception.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Kansas (3-5, 1-4) has won three of its four games on home turf this fall, most recently a 25-24 comeback against Baylor that cost their head coach, Dave Aranda, his job. The Jayhawks face uncertainty behind center; their top three quarterbacks — Isaiah Marshall , Cole Ballard and Chase Jenkins — were all listed as questionable on the Big 12's first availability report of the week.
